title: Complete native and hosted replay of the R438 bit improvement
body:
Completes #2653 / Discussion1289's handoff for #2423's fixed R438 word and layout. Fresh emitted/native evidence reproduces bit c=0.001734846264120199151475, with 904896 -> 904320 paid child calls (+0.08187% bit endpoint). No new κ: the accepted complex supplier still binds; the selected frontier is unchanged.

New relative to predecessors: actual hosted emission, all 126144 emitted owner/projector bindings, the charged rank-34 remainder, and a complete reproducible native/hosted invoice. The word, layout, geometric proof and predicted endpoint retain predecessor credit. Timing-dependent hash links are normalized only after their original integrity checks pass.

Reproduce: `python3 -B research/r438-native-rehost/verify.py`
Requires Python 3.12, C++17/Boost and the package's pinned Python requirements. Expected: PASS_R438_NATIVE_REHOST, c as above, no_new_kappa.

Executed: fresh 5/9/11-stage native checks on both words; both complete parent/hosted pipelines and exact moment engines; 96 bridge, 66 template, 10 projector controls/witnesses and 9 new semantic rejection controls; registered local replay; -O rejection; source/commit-byte preflight. No full repository or selected-frontier cold replay.

Finite conditional evidence only. All-size compiler, common-label realization, whole-call hosting, physical routing, precision/tape and analytic transfer remain inherited; no full formal theorem or independent human review.
